policy.promotionRequires: an accepted contract, exact runner-ready profile, direct native evidence, independent oracle, and terminal cleanup
mutationProhibited: GPU mode, clocks, power, fans, persistence, ECC, MIG, compute mode, or reset
Hyper-V GPU partition, DDA assignment, VM configuration, or device dismount
production workload, display attachment, or administrator-owned provider state

upstreamSources.use: vendor support boundary for DDA and GPU-P
DDA host, device, and security prerequisites

axes.currentBoundary: device zero, one private context, and no public device selector
requiredEnvironment: at least two visible physical CUDA GPUs
requiredEvidence: accepted device-selection and per-device ownership contract
safetyRules: omit UUID, serial, and bus identifiers from public evidence
do not reset or reconfigure devices

axes.currentBoundary: MIG identity, isolation, quotas, and lifecycle are not modeled
requiredEnvironment: at least two administrator-preconfigured MIG instances
safetyRules: never enable, disable, repartition, or reset MIG
omit instance UUIDs and bus identifiers from public evidence

axes.currentBoundary: virtualization mechanisms require separate host/guest/provider profiles
requiredEnvironment: vendor-supported GPU-P, DDA, passthrough, or vGPU host
requiredEvidence: guest F2 through F8 native chain
safetyRules: never configure a VM or GPU assignment
never dismount, partition, or reset a device

axes.currentBoundary: exact SPEC-0018 capacity-two profile is qualified; broader capacities, cross-stream dependency waits, priorities and operation classes remain unimplemented and unqualified
requiredEnvironment: kernels with an overlap mechanism oracle
requiredEvidence: overlap mechanism evidence and terminal cleanup
safetyRules: do not infer overlap from wall-clock timing alone
retain exact resource leases until each operation is terminal
do not expose raw streams/events merely to demonstrate concurrency

axes.currentBoundary: versioned public-package short and bounded-soak observation profiles exist; exact native evidence remains observational and cannot promote product performance or production stability
requiredEvidence: temperature, power, clocks, throttle reasons, CPU/GPU memory
correctness and terminal cleanup before and after soak
safetyRules: never change clocks, power, fans, persistence, or thermal policy
never convert regression ceilings into product performance claims

axes.currentBoundary: ECC capability and error-health semantics are not in the runtime contract
safetyRules: never inject destructive faults or reset the GPU

axes.currentBoundary: only exact recorded Node, Driver, toolkit/header, provider, and GPU cells are supported
requiredEvidence: full F2 through F8 chain per promoted cell
automatic invalidation when a compatibility key changes
safetyRules: do not replace exact failed cells with family-level labels

axes.currentBoundary: the accepted Windows profile is Windows 11 x64 WDDM with watchdog enabled
requiredEnvironment: supported Windows Server or workstation TCC host
requiredEvidence: F1 through F8 native and package chain
safetyRules: never switch WDDM/TCC or compute mode

axes.currentBoundary: contributor bundles are hashed and sanitized but are not independently tamper-proof
requiredEvidence: verifiable source SHA/tree and runner image identity
safetyRules: never run untrusted fork code automatically on persistent GPU hosts
never expose infrastructure secrets or private raw logs
